# Pack: ticket-triage

Triages new and updated Redmine, JIRA and ServiceNow tickets - a cited triage draft for a person to send (L1), or a status or assignment change that runs only after a person approves it (L2).

| Kind | `automation` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | no |

- Default in: none
- Optional in: [`cluster-manager`](../bundles/cluster-manager.md), [`cms-comp-ops`](../bundles/cms-comp-ops.md)
